findings.problem: Without a hint, "souvenir" could also get "el souvenir", a loanword that is very common across Latin America (Mexico, Argentina, Peru and others), so the prompt has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: the native Spanish word, not the borrowed "souvenir"

back.example: I brought you a souvenir from Mexico.

note: The new hint also keeps this card apart from the "memory" card, which uses the same word.
